context.transcript:
Hi, Francesca.
The graphic designer just sent us some sample logos for our camping company.
Since you'll be updating our company's Web site, I wanted to get your opinion on which one would look best.
Sw Let's see...
I like the second one.
The image and fonts are really clean, so it'll be easy for me to integrate it into our existing Web site.
But I don't like the color.
I agree.
A lot of other companies that make camping gear already use green logos.
What if we use orange instead?
Good idea.
Let's get the team's opinion during tomorrow's meeting.
context.transcript_translation:
嗨，Francesca。
平面设计师刚刚给我们发送了一些关于我们露营公司的样品标志。
因为你正在更新我们公司的网站，我想听听你的意见，看看哪个看起来最好。
让我们看看……
我喜欢第二个。
图像和字体都很干净，这样对我来说很容易将其整合到我们现有的网站中。
但我不喜欢这个颜色。
我同意。
很多制作露营装备的公司已经在使用绿色标志了。
如果我们用橙色怎么样？
好主意。
我们明天会议上听取团队的意见吧。
